headline: Indian Rupee Settles Flat at 94.46 Against US Dollar
summary: The Indian rupee settled flat at 94.46 against the US dollar after moving in an intraday range between 94.36 and 94.57 at the interbank foreign exchange market.
why: Foreign exchange rates reflect capital flows, trade balances, and central bank currency interventions in emerging economies.

impacts.name: USD/INR
impacts.why: Interbank foreign exchange trading establishes the daily valuation of the rupee against the US dollar.
